sources.snippet: Jaddangi AI Telugu 78M Instruct is a custom-built, 78-million parameter Transformer model designed specifically for the Telugu language. Built entirely from scratch, this model features advanced architectural optimizations like Grouped Query Attention (GQA) and SwiGLU activations, making it highly efficient for local hardware (e.g., i3 processors, 12GB RAM).
